commented_code:
+name: 'DSW SWE-bench Verified Release'
+
+on:
+  release:
+    types: ['published']
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      release_tag:
+        description: 'Existing test/prerelease to receive the result'
+        required: true
+        type: 'string'
+      qwen_release_tag:
+        description: 'Published Qwen npm release to evaluate (defaults to release_tag)'
+        required: false
+        type: 'string'
+      instance_limit:
+        description: 'Number of Verified instances (500 is the full suite)'
+        required: true
+        default: '1'
+        type: 'choice'
+        options:
+          - '1'
+          - '5'
+          - '500'
+      instance_id:
+        description: 'Exact Verified instance when instance_limit is 1'
+        required: false
+        default: 'sympy__sympy-20590'
+        type: 'string'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: 'read'
+
+concurrency:
+  group: 'dsw-swe-verified-release'
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+jobs:
+  release_gate:
+    name: 'Check benchmark release'
+    if: |-
+      ${{ github.repository == 'QwenLM/qwen-code' }}
+    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
+    outputs:
+      should_run: '${{ steps.gate.outputs.should_run }}'
+    steps:
+      - name: 'Check release version'
+        id: 'gate'
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: '${{ github.event_name }}'
+          RELEASE_TAG: '${{ github.event.release.tag_name || '''' }}'
+          RELEASE_PRERELEASE: '${{ github.event.release.prerelease || false }}'
+        run: |-
+          should_run='false'
+          if [[ "${EVENT_NAME}" == 'workflow_dispatch' ]]; then
+            should_run='true'
+          elif [[ "${RELEASE_PRERELEASE}" == 'false' && "${RELEASE_TAG}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.0$ ]]; then
+            should_run='true'
+          fi
+          echo "should_run=${should_run}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
+          if [[ "${should_run}" == 'false' ]]; then
+            echo "::notice::Skipping benchmark for ${RELEASE_TAG:-non-release event}"
+          fi
+
+  benchmark:
+    name: 'Dispatch SWE-bench Verified to DSW'
+    needs: 'release_gate'
+    if: '${{ needs.release_gate.outputs.should_run == ''true'' }}'
+    runs-on: ['self-hosted', 'Linux', 'X64', 'qwen-benchmark-dsw']
+    timeout-minutes: 15
+    env:
+      RELEASE_TAG: '${{ github.event_name == ''release'' && github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.release_tag }}'
+      QWEN_REF: '${{ github.event_name == ''release'' && github.event.release.tag_name || inputs.qwen_release_tag || inputs.release_tag }}'
+      INSTANCE_LIMIT: '${{ github.event_name == ''release'' && ''500'' || inputs.instance_limit }}'
+      BENCHMARK_INSTANCE_ID: '${{ (github.event_name != ''release'' && inputs.instance_limit == ''1'') && inputs.instance_id || '''' }}'
+      RELEASE_ID: '${{ github.event_name == ''release'' && github.event.release.id || '''' }}'
+      BENCHMARK_TRIGGER: '${{ github.event_name }}'

**[Suggestion]** `RELEASE_ID` is set at the job-level `env:` from the raw release event, but the dispatch step (line 126) overrides it with `${{ steps.release.outputs.release_id }}` sourced from the API. The job-level value never reaches any consumer.

Failure scenario: A maintainer changing how `RELEASE_ID` is computed at the job level (e.g., adding a fallback) would expect the dispatch script to receive the new value, but the step-level override silently takes precedence.

Suggested fix: Remove the job-level `RELEASE_ID` line. The step-level `env:` on the dispatch step is the authoritative and sole consumer.

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_

+name: 'Core Review Router'
+
+on:
+  pull_request_target:
+    types: ['opened', 'synchronize', 'ready_for_review']
+    paths: ['packages/core/**']
+
+permissions:
+  contents: 'read'
+  pull-requests: 'write'
+
+jobs:
+  route:
+    if: |-
+      !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
+      !contains(fromJSON('["wenshao","tanzhenxin","yiliang114","LaZzyMan"]'), github.event.pull_request.user.login)
+    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'
+    timeout-minutes: 5
+    concurrency:
+      group: 'core-review-router-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+      cancel-in-progress: true
+    steps:
+      - name: 'Checkout router script'
+        uses: 'actions/checkout@df4cb1c069e1874edd31b4311f1884172cec0e10'  # v6.0.3
+        with:
+          ref: '${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}'
+          sparse-checkout: '.github/scripts/core-review-router.mjs'
+          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
+
+      - name: 'Collect changed files'
+        id: 'files'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: '${{ github.token }}'
+          PR_NUMBER: '${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+        run: |-
+          set -euo pipefail
+          files="$(gh api --paginate "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100" --jq '.[].filename' | jq -R . | jq -sc '.')"
+          {
+            echo 'files<<EOF'
+            echo "$files"
+            echo 'EOF'
+          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: 'Classify and pick reviewers'
+        id: 'classify'
+        env:
+          FILES: '${{ steps.files.outputs.files }}'
+          AUTHOR: '${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}'
+          PR_NUMBER: '${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+        run: |-
+          set -euo pipefail
+          result="$(node .github/scripts/core-review-router.mjs --files "$FILES" --author "$AUTHOR" --pr "$PR_NUMBER")"
+          reviewers="$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reviewers | join(",")')"
+          reason="$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reason')"
+          echo "reviewers=$reviewers" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "reason=$reason" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Routing decision: reviewers=[$reviewers] reason=$reason"
+
+      - name: 'Apply review requests'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: '${{ github.token }}'
+          PR_NUMBER: '${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+          REVIEWERS: '${{ steps.classify.outputs.reviewers }}'
+          REASON: '${{ steps.classify.outputs.reason }}'
+        run: |-
+          set -euo pipefail
+          api="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/requested_reviewers"
+          maintainers='["wenshao","tanzhenxin","yiliang114","LaZzyMan"]'

+            echo 'files<<EOF'
+            echo "$files"
+            echo 'EOF'
+          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: 'Classify and pick reviewers'
+        id: 'classify'
+        env:
+          FILES: '${{ steps.files.outputs.files }}'
+          AUTHOR: '${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}'
+          PR_NUMBER: '${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+        run: |-
+          set -euo pipefail
+          result="$(node .github/scripts/core-review-router.mjs --files "$FILES" --author "$AUTHOR" --pr "$PR_NUMBER")"
+          reviewers="$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reviewers | join(",")')"
+          reason="$(echo "$result" | jq -r '.reason')"
+          echo "reviewers=$reviewers" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "reason=$reason" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "Routing decision: reviewers=[$reviewers] reason=$reason"
+
+      - name: 'Apply review requests'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: '${{ github.token }}'
+          PR_NUMBER: '${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}'
+          REVIEWERS: '${{ steps.classify.outputs.reviewers }}'
+          REASON: '${{ steps.classify.outputs.reason }}'
+        run: |-
+          set -euo pipefail
+          api="repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/requested_reviewers"
+          maintainers='["wenshao","tanzhenxin","yiliang114","LaZzyMan"]'

**[Suggestion]** Maintainer list hardcoded in 3 places — drift breaks the diff guard — Concrete cost: when a maintainer is added to `MAINTAINERS` in the script but the apply step's `maintainers=` is not updated in sync, the new maintainer is selected by `classify()` and POSTed as a reviewer, but `managed` (computed as `current ∩ maintainers`) excludes them. The diff guard (`if [ "$managed" = "$desired" ]`) then never matches, so every `synchronize` event triggers a spurious POST re-request, and if routing later decides to remove them, `to_remove = managed - desired` never includes them — they remain a requested reviewer indefinitely.

```suggestion
          maintainers="$(echo "$REVIEWERS" | tr ',' '\n' | jq -R . | jq -sc '.')"
          # Or: have the script output the full maintainer list in its JSON,
          # then read it from steps.classify.outputs.maintainers
```
